remarks: Welcome home to this brand-new manufactured home offering an exceptional layout, modern comforts, and plenty of space for entertaining, relaxing, and everyday living. The split floorplan provides privacy and flexibility, featuring two spacious master suites, plus an additional guest room/office. The heart of the home is the large gourmet kitchen, complete with a generous island and plenty of room for meal preparation, entertaining, and gathering with family and friends. The home also features a dedicated family/craft room, a separate living room, and air conditioning for year-round comfort.
